description: This file contains NEON-accelerated implementations of image processing functions, specifically downsampling functions and a function to compute the gradient matrix, for use in object tracking within the TensorFlow Android tools.

methods.name: void Downsample2x32ColumnsNeon(const uint8_t * const original,const int stride,const int orig_x)
methods.description: Performs NEON-accelerated 2x downsampling of image columns.

methods.name: void Downsample4x32ColumnsNeon(const uint8_t * const original,const int stride,const int orig_x)
methods.description: Performs NEON-accelerated 4x downsampling of image columns.

methods.name: void DownsampleAveragedNeon(const uint8_t * const original,const int stride,const int factor)
methods.description: Selects and calls appropriate downsampling method based on the factor and processes the image data.

methods.name: void CalculateGNeon(const float * const vals_x,const float * const vals_y,const int num_vals,float * const G)
methods.description: Calculates the gradient matrix using NEON vectorized operations for given input gradient values.
